width.meaning: distance between the two outer side faces of the crate, along x

depth.meaning: distance between the front and back outer faces of the crate, along z

height.meaning: height of the crate from the floor to the top face

slat_count.meaning: number of slats across the top, counted along z

slat_gap.meaning: share of each slat pitch left open between neighbouring slats

tilt.meaning: angle of the lid about the x axis when the crate is open
